lines.beaver: 민수 씨, 창업 준비는 잘 돼 가요?
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, how's your startup prep going?
lines.beaver_roman: minsu ssi, changeop junbineun jal dwae gayo?
lines.en: Not great. The business plan is harder than I thought.

lines.beaver_en: What kind of business are you planning?
lines.en: I want to sell farm and livestock products from farming households and farms.

lines.learner: 네, 농축산물은 물론이려니와 수산물도 팔 거예요.
lines.en: Yes, not only farm and livestock products but seafood too.
lines.roman: ne, nongchuksanmureun mulloniryeoniwa susanmuldo pal geoyeyo.

lines.learner: 땅값은 물론이려니와 창고 비용도 커서 걱정이에요.
lines.en: Not only land prices but warehouse costs are high, so I'm worried.
lines.roman: ttangkkapseun mulloniryeoniwa changgo biyongdo keoseo geokjeongieyo.

lines.learner: 재고가 쌓이면 손해라서 판매량을 먼저 봐야 해요.
lines.en: Piled-up stock is a loss, so I need to check sales volume first.
lines.roman: jaegoga ssaimyeon sonhaeraseo panmaeryangeul meonjeo bwaya haeyo.

lines.learner: 온라인 마케팅으로 새 시장을 개척하고 싶어요.
lines.en: I want to open up a new market with online marketing.
lines.roman: ollain maketingeuro sae sijangeul gaecheokago sipeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Are there many competitors in this field?
lines.learner: 대기업은 물론이려니와 중소기업도 이 일을 해요.
lines.en: Not only big companies but small businesses do this too.
lines.roman: daegieobeun mulloniryeoniwa jungsogieopdo i ireul haeyo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 경쟁이 심하겠네요. 물건은 잘 구할 수 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: Then competition must be tough. Can you get products easily?
lines.beaver_roman: geureom gyeongjaengi simhagenneyo. mulgeoneun jal guhal su isseoyo?
lines.learner: 올해는 풍년이라서 논에서 쌀이 많이 나왔대요.
lines.en: It's a bumper year, so they say the paddies gave lots of rice.
lines.roman: olhaeneun pungnyeoniraseo noneseo ssari mani nawatdaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Good news. What's your next step?
lines.learner: 다음 달에는 축산 농가도 찾아가 볼 거예요.
lines.en: Next month I'll visit livestock farmers too.
lines.roman: daeum dareneun chuksan nonggado chajaga bol geoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Nice. Let's cheer each other on!
lines.learner: 고마워요. 지은 씨 창업도 잘되길 바랄게요.
lines.en: Thanks. I hope your startup goes well too, Jieun.
lines.roman: gomawoyo. jieun ssi changeopdo jaldoegil baralgeyo.
